elements.text: An industrial tech mod powered by FE. The path runs from ore processing to machines, then to heat and multiblocks, to the magnet accelerator and finally the Dyson panel.
Opened with the Information Panel. Here you will find mechanics, how machines and multiblocks work, and the order of progression — what unlocks what and how it functions.
Everything starts with the machine casing. The Coal Generator gives your first FE. The Crusher doubles ore into dust; the Electric Furnace smelts dust and ore into ingots.
Crush ore or raw material for 2 dust instead of 1 ingot, then smelt the dust. Result: double the metal from every ore.
Everything runs on Forge Energy (FE). Generators produce FE, cables carry it, machines keep a small buffer and spend FE per tick of work.
Each cable has its own transfer limit; generators and stores have their own capacity. Watch the balance of production and draw.
